messages.lead: Standard entry to the **Master in Artificial Intelligence (Conventional)**: a Bachelor's degree (MQF Level 6) in a related field with a minimum CGPA of **2.50**. Lower CGPAs (from **2.00**) can be accepted subject to a rigorous assessment or prerequisite courses. You need to meet **any one** route.
details: i. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, as accepted by the HEP Senate; OR

ii. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP; OR

iii. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR

iv. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses; OR

v. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR

vi. Other qualifications equivalent to a Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering, or in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields, recognised by the Government of Malaysia, which must fulfil the requirements in items (i) to (v).
For candidates without a Computing degree, prerequisite module(s) should be taken to adequately prepare them for advanced study.

messages.text:
Standard entry to the **Master in Artificial Intelligence (Conventional)**: a Bachelor's degree (MQF Level 6) in a related field with a minimum CGPA of **2.50**. Lower CGPAs (from **2.00**) can be accepted subject to a rigorous assessment or prerequisite courses. You need to meet **any one** route.
- i\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, as accepted by the HEP Senate; OR
- ii\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP; OR
- iii\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR
- iv\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses; OR
- v\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR
- vi\. Other qualifications equivalent to a Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering, or in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields, recognised by the Government of Malaysia, which must fulfil the requirements in items (i) to (v).
- For candidates without a Computing degree, prerequisite module(s) should be taken to adequately prepare them for advanced study.
- Achieve a minimum of Band 4 in the Malaysian University English Test (MUET) or the equivalent of CEFR (Low B2). If an applicant does not meet this requirement, the HEP must offer English proficiency courses to ensure that the candidate's proficiency is sufficient to meet the needs of the programme.

messages.lead: Standard entry to the **Master in Artificial Intelligence (Conventional)**: a Bachelor's degree (MQF Level 6) in a related field with a minimum CGPA of **2.50**. Lower CGPAs (from **2.00**) can be accepted subject to a rigorous assessment or prerequisite courses. You need to meet **any one** route.
details: i. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, as accepted by the HEP Senate; OR

ii. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP; OR

iii. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR

iv. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses; OR

v. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR

vi. Other qualifications equivalent to a Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering, or in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields, recognised by the Government of Malaysia, which must fulfil the requirements in items (i) to (v).
For candidates without a Computing degree, prerequisite module(s) should be taken to adequately prepare them for advanced study.

messages.text:
Standard entry to the **Master in Artificial Intelligence (Conventional)**: a Bachelor's degree (MQF Level 6) in a related field with a minimum CGPA of **2.50**. Lower CGPAs (from **2.00**) can be accepted subject to a rigorous assessment or prerequisite courses. You need to meet **any one** route.
- i\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, as accepted by the HEP Senate; OR
- ii\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 and not meeting a CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP; OR
- iii\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR
- iv\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses; OR
- v\. A Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, accepted subject to a thorough rigorous assessment as determined by the HEP to identify the appropriate prerequisite courses equivalent to the applicant's working experience in Artificial Intelligence or related fields; OR
- vi\. Other qualifications equivalent to a Bachelor's degree (Level 6, MQF) in Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering, or in non-Artificial Intelligence / Computing / Science, Technology and Engineering fields, recognised by the Government of Malaysia, which must fulfil the requirements in items (i) to (v).
- For candidates without a Computing degree, prerequisite module(s) should be taken to adequately prepare them for advanced study.
- Achieve a minimum of Band 4 in the Malaysian University English Test (MUET) or the equivalent of CEFR (Low B2). If an applicant does not meet this requirement, the HEP must offer English proficiency courses to ensure that the candidate's proficiency is sufficient to meet the needs of the programme.
